merchant/30085.htm.text: Weapons Trader Stanford: Welcome, youngster! Our shop only specializes in weapons. In fact, most of the famous knights of Aden come here. Why don't you choose one for yourself? We carry a wide selection, and only the best!

merchant/30085-pk.htm.text: Weapons Trader Stanford: I won't say it twice. You're a nuisance to the other customers, so please leave!
